name: user-management
description: Full superspace-parity user management (P0–P4c): UserManagementPanel tabs Members + Roles + Teams + Access. Member table, invites (with hierarchy propagation), roles admin (permission matrix), teams, generic tenant-hierarchy tree, and a cross-tenant AccessMatrix (users × tenants). All permission-gated. Props-driven + RBAC-agnostic; pair with rbac-roles + convex-auth.
notes: 0.6.0 (2026-05-31): P4c — cross-tenant AccessMatrix (users × tenants grid, inline role assign; convex hierarchy/getAccessMatrix walks root + descendants). Completes the superspace-parity epic. 0.5.0: P4b — tenant hierarchy + propagating invites. Generic um_tenant_links edge tree (rr never owns the tenant entities). convex/features/user-management/hierarchy/{query,mutation}: linkTenant/unlinkTenant + sendHierarchyInvite (same | decreasing role strategy, BFS descendants) + listChildTenants/getDescendantTenants. InviteDialog gains an optional propagate toggle (allowPropagate prop). 0.4.0: P4a — teams (um_teams + um_team_members; TeamsPanel + TeamDetail; createTeam/removeTeam/addTeamMember/removeTeamMember + listTeams, gated members.manage). UserManagementPanel gains an optional Teams tab. 0.3.0: P3 — roles admin (UserManagementPanel tabs; RolesPanel + RoleEditor + RolePermissionGrid create/edit/delete custom roles, system roles read-only). Roles CRUD reuses rbac-roles' listRoles/upsertRole/removeRole — no new convex here. 0.2.0: invite flow (um_invites). 0.1.0: members table. RBAC-agnostic by design — the slice imports no other slice's frontend; roles + resolved permissions + permission catalog are passed as props (wire from rbac-roles at the app level). Full-parity extras (P4: hierarchy/teams/access-matrix) follow.
